SpeciesDescription.Wolf_Gray: Gray wolf: pack predator, courts in winter, no feeding required, aggressive during courtship.
SpeciesDescription.Wolf_Coyote: Coyote: small predator, courts in winter, no feeding required, smaller than the gray wolf.
SpeciesDescription.Hyena: Hyena: pack scavenger predator, courts in spring, no feeding required.
SpeciesDescription.Lion: Lion: apex pack predator, courts in summer, no feeding required, very high attack power.
SpeciesDescription.Tiger: Tiger: solitary apex predator, courts in autumn, no feeding required, very high attack power.
SpeciesDescription.Tiger_White: White tiger: rare tiger variant, courts in autumn, no feeding required.
SpeciesDescription.Leopard: Leopard: agile predator, courts in autumn, no feeding required.
SpeciesDescription.Jaguar: Jaguar: tropical predator, courts in summer, no feeding required.
SpeciesDescription.Bear: Grizzly bear: large omnivorous predator, courts in summer, no feeding required, high attack power.
SpeciesDescription.Bear_Brown: Brown bear: large omnivorous predator, courts in summer, no feeding required, similar to the grizzly.
SpeciesDescription.Bear_Black: Black bear: medium omnivorous predator, courts in summer, no feeding required, smaller than the brown bear.
SpeciesDescription.Bear_Polar: Polar bear: large arctic predator, courts in winter, no feeding required, extremely high attack power.
SpeciesDescription.Horse_Black: Black horse: gentle herbivorous mount, courts in spring, feed tall grass, stallions fight over mares.
SpeciesDescription.Horse_Bay: Bay horse: gentle herbivorous mount, courts in spring, feed tall grass, stallions fight over mares.
SpeciesDescription.Horse_Chestnut: Chestnut horse: gentle herbivorous mount, courts in spring, feed tall grass, stallions fight over mares.
SpeciesDescription.Horse_Palomino: Palomino horse: gentle herbivorous mount, courts in spring, feed tall grass, stallions fight over mares.
SpeciesDescription.Horse_White: White horse: gentle herbivorous mount, courts in spring, feed tall grass, stallions fight over mares.
SpeciesDescription.Donkey: Donkey: herbivorous animal, can be saddled and ridden, courts in spring, feed tall grass.
SpeciesDescription.Camel: Camel: herbivorous mount, courts in summer, feed tall grass, longer gestation.
SpeciesDescription.Reindeer: Reindeer: arctic herbivorous mount, courts in winter, feed tall grass.
SpeciesDescription.Ostrich: Ostrich: tropical herbivorous mount, courts in spring, feed pumpkin, breeds quickly.
SpeciesDescription.Cassowary: Cassowary: large flightless bird, courts in summer, no feeding required, aggressive.
SpeciesDescription.Cow: Cow: livestock, courts in spring and summer, feed tall grass, can breed with bulls.
SpeciesDescription.Bull: Bull: livestock, courts in spring and summer, feed tall grass, can breed with cows.
SpeciesDescription.Cow_Black: Black cow: livestock variant, courts in spring and summer, no feeding required, breeds with any bull color.
SpeciesDescription.Cow_Brown: Brown cow: livestock variant, courts in spring and summer, no feeding required, breeds with any bull color.
SpeciesDescription.Bull_Brown: Brown bull: livestock variant, courts in spring and summer, no feeding required, breeds with cows.
SpeciesDescription.Bull_Black: Black bull: livestock variant, courts in spring and summer, no feeding required, breeds with cows.
SpeciesDescription.Bull_White: White bull: livestock variant, courts in spring and summer, no feeding required, breeds with cows.
SpeciesDescription.Alpaca: Alpaca: gentle herbivore, courts in spring and autumn, feed tall grass, can be sheared.
SpeciesDescription.Alpaca_Shorn: Shorn alpaca: variant after shearing, courts in spring and autumn, no feeding required.
SpeciesDescription.Alpaca_White: White alpaca: alpaca variant, courts in spring and autumn, no feeding required.
SpeciesDescription.Gnu: Gnu: herd herbivore, courts in autumn, feed tall grass.
SpeciesDescription.Bison: Bison: large herbivore, courts in autumn, feed tall grass, moderately aggressive.
SpeciesDescription.Moose: Moose: large arctic herbivore, courts in autumn, no feeding required, bulls are larger.
SpeciesDescription.Rhino: Rhino: large herbivore, courts in summer, no feeding required, aggressive.
SpeciesDescription.Giraffe: Giraffe: very large herbivore, courts in summer, no feeding required, longer gestation.
SpeciesDescription.Zebra: Zebra: herd herbivore, courts in spring, no feeding required, wary.
SpeciesDescription.Wildboar: Wildboar: omnivorous medium animal, courts in autumn, no feeding required.
